subject: A couple questions about using brush in shiny plots

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: A couple questions about using brush in shiny plots
parts:
I'm not sure if I should ask here or on a ggplot2 board.  I have a few questions about using the brush feature in plots. If someone has an answer to any of them, that'll be helpful.

1. Is it possible to "clear" the brushed area? After a brush is finished, I record the coordinates and perform an action, but I'd like to be able to remove the painted rectangle and "reset" the plot (without having to literally to-render the plot). I'm wondering if this is possible.

2. Is it possible to only fire the brush event when the brushing action is done instead of multiple times during the brush?  I know there are two "delay types" (debounce and throttle) but according to the docs, both of them will fire multiple times within the same "brushing session".

3. I've asked this yesterday but I might as well as it here for completion. Is it possible to differentiate a click from a brush? https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/aOGS486quFc

Thanks in advance if anyone has any answers
